''"This shouldn't take long.|The Trandoshan and Omega, before a game of balaans|}} A '''[[Trandoshan]]''' spent time in a [[Unidentified cantina (Lau)|cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Lau]], [[gambling]] against other [[cantina]] patrons in the card game [[balaans]].{{Databank|balaans|balaans}} During or after [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|304}} the [[Cloning|clones]] [[Crosshair]] and [[Omega]] crashed on the planet after escaping imprisonment by the [[Galactic Empire]]. In need of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], they visited the cantina, where Omega played against the Trandoshan in multiple rounds of balaans. The Trandoshan initially underestimated Omega, but soon realized the young clone was exceptionally skilled at the game. Despite losing a hefty amount of credits, the Trandoshan continued to play in the hopes of making back the money he had lost. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|A Different Approach}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-a-different-approach|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "A Different Approach"}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი ტრანდოშანი (ლაუ) }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Trandoshans]]
